page: Amazon Web Services c7i.metal-24xl is a bare-metal, compute-optimized server instance featuring dedicated Intel Xeon 8488C processors built on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration delivers 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, but it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 38 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in multi-core processing and specialized instruction sets. The server achieved top-decile scores in Geekbench multi-core execution, software compilation with Clang, and ray tracing. Passmark CPU testing placed the instance in the top 10% overall, supported by strong encryption performance. The underlying Intel Xeon architecture supports Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512, which facilitate efficient vector and matrix operations.

Memory performance is characterized by a strong read-only cached bandwidth of 7016.02 GB/sec and an uncached large-block read bandwidth of 213.73 GB/sec. The instance demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations, achieving 104.57 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks, and high-throughput static web serving at 77.29 GB/sec. Given the high compute density, dedicated bare-metal access, and lack of local storage, this server is optimized for CPU-bound workloads, software compilation, cryptography, and memory-cached database operations that leverage external storage solutions.
